title: First Asian Games gold goes to Japan as China's 13-year-old Yu lights up pool
summary: The first gold medal of the 20th Asian Games was won on Sunday by host nation Japan as a 13-year-old swimmer from China started in blistering form on the opening day of the multisports extravaganza.
